_note: Example contour levels for contours.py --levels-file. The criterion limit from the criteria registry is always added. Example only - choose levels that match the rules of your jurisdiction.
_noise_note: 45 dB(A) = IFC (2007) General EHS Guidelines Table 1.7.1 night-time residential value; 35 and 40 are intermediate display levels in 5 dB steps.
_flicker_note: LAI (2020) WKA-Schattenwurfhinweise: 30 h/year astronomical worst case; 8 h/year actual shadow flicker where a shutdown system is installed.
